mapper.sql: e.id, e.company_name, e.credit_code, e.register_region_city, DATE_FORMAT(e.establishment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS establishment_date, e.registered_capital, e.enterprise_type, e.industry_name, e.staff_count_min, e.staff_count_max, e.annual_revenue, e.enterprise_status, e.tax_qualification, e.tax_abnormal_status, e.is_in_abnormal_operation_list, e.pending_abnormal_count, e.contact_count, e.has_contact, e.ai_potential_score, e.is_hot, e.register_address
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM acq_enterprise e
ORDER BY e.establishment_date DESC ORDER BY e.establishment_date ASC ORDER BY e.registered_capital DESC ORDER BY e.registered_capital ASC ORDER BY e.ai_potential_score DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.tax_abnormal_status != 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS taxAbnormalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.has_tax_arrears = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS taxArrearsCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.has_major_tax_violation = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS majorViolationCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.has_tax_penalty = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS taxPenaltyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.is_in_abnormal_operation_list = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operationAbnormalCount FROM acq_enterprise e
